bio: Here, the bouillabaisse cosies up to the aioli and the pissaladière (tart with onions, olives and anchovies) hobnobs with the socca (chickpea flatbread), hot from the charcoal-fired oven: Julia Sedefdjian is happy and thriving. Her colourful, fragrant cuisine is an ode to the Mediterranean: roast and stewed venison, puntarelle and gnocchi or Kintoa pork, bao of BBQ pork belly, stuffed cabbage and jus… Julia painstakingly selects and creatively blends premium produce, without forgetting her Nice heritage. The Bouillabaieta, a superb take on bouillabaisse, is a must and your tastebuds will be in seventh heaven as you embrace her surprise menu, Baieta (which means kiss in the Nice dialect)!...
